name: Jeroen Cottaar
method: Read-only public Kaggle About and Competitions pages in the Claude desktop app's built-in browser on 2026-10-30. Each page was loaded once, with a wait of about six seconds before reading and five seconds between the two pages. Text was read from the rendered page, medal icons were read from a screenshot of the completed-competitions list and matched against the icon labels in the page, and the avatar image address was read from the profile's background-image element. The pane carried an existing Kaggle sign-in; only content visible on the public profile was recorded. No block, captcha or rate limit appeared. This file replaces an older draft that was written while Kaggle was blocking us; nothing from that draft was kept without being seen again on the live pages.

facts.text: Jeroen Cottaar is a Kaggle Competitions Grandmaster, ranked 6th of 225,021 in the competitions ranking, with five gold and two silver competition medals on his public profile.
facts.sourceTitle: Jeroen Cottaar — public Kaggle profile, tier, rank and medals

facts.text: His Kaggle profile lists him as an AI Researcher at Tufa Labs, based in Eindhoven in the Netherlands, and dates his account to May 2023.
facts.sourceTitle: Jeroen Cottaar — public Kaggle profile headline and join date

facts.text: Kaggle lists his completed Santa 2025 Christmas Tree Packing Challenge entry 1st of 3,357 teams and his NeurIPS Ariel Data Challenge 2025 entry 1st of 860 teams, both with gold medals and both shown under his account alone.
facts.sourceTitle: Jeroen Cottaar — completed Santa 2025 and Ariel 2025 results on Kaggle

facts.text: He is also listed 2nd of 1,365 teams in the Yale/UNC-CH Geophysical Waveform Inversion competition and 2nd of 1,151 teams in the 2024 NeurIPS Ariel Data Challenge, both with gold medals.
facts.sourceTitle: Jeroen Cottaar — completed Waveform Inversion and Ariel 2024 results on Kaggle

facts.text: His Kaggle competitions page shows him entered in both ARC Prize 2026 competitions, ARC-AGI-2 and ARC-AGI-3, which it lists as still running.

teamNotes: Current: the Kaggle competitions page shows him on both active ARC Prize 2026 competitions. The team name Tufa Labs comes only from this project's own public roster observations of the ARC boards (checked 29 October 2026, teams 15486995 and 16756524) and was not re-read on Kaggle today; any standing from those boards is provisional until the competition closes. Past: six of the seven completed entries display only his own account. The CZII - CryoET Object Identification entry (11th of 931, gold) displays two accounts, davidlist and jeroencottaar, so that medal is a shared team medal and must not be credited to him alone. Kaggle's completed-competition list does not display team names, so no team name is asserted for any past entry. His profile medal total counts that team medal.
